_doc: Input of make_done_exclusions.py: the short list of MEMOS #70 (3), designs that may stay out of the DoD-5 band (exact or at most 15 % over), each with its per-array cause, the Vitis evidence and why it is out of scope. 'status' says whether Peter has accepted the entry; 'proposed' entries come from a prove report and wait for him. '_withdrawn' keeps entries taken off the list, with the reason; the script ignores it.

_withdrawn.cause: conv1d_2 / conv1d_3 / conv1d_4: Vitis does not flatten the parent loop with its auto-pipelined child ([HLS 200-960] '... either the parent loop or sub loop is do-while loop'), so the child runs alone at II 1 and the temp_* weights are RAM_1WNR with 4 copies; hls-est flattens, gets II 10 and RAM_2P (-156); the remaining -3 is a register-sized array
_withdrawn.vitis_evidence: VITIS_NOTES N64 (11 kernels w9r8p_*) and N76 (9 kernels w9r9p_n64_*): the refusal does not depend on the parent's trip count (92/64), the element type (float/int), the nesting depth (x loop removed) or the child's trip (5/3); it disappears with an explicit pipeline on the child (n64_cpipe) or an explicit unroll on the grandchild (n64_kunr), and with an if on c or k inside the grandchild (n64_ifconly / n64_ifkonly), but not with an if on l + k (n64_iflonly, the ECG shape) or without an if (dw_noif); in every refused kernel db/a.o.1.ll has the parent l in do-while form with the hoisted address l + 1 as its increment
_withdrawn.why_out_of_scope: candidate rule (N76, unconfirmed): a parent is not flattened when its child is pipelined only by the automatic pipeline (214-376), the child holds a sub-loop that only that pipeline unrolls (214-291), and no condition on the child's or sub-loop's index guards the sub-loop body; it is backed by 13 kernels but its two flattening exceptions (if on c / k) are not derived from a mechanism, and 10 of the 14 corpus designs with this warning are exact today, so adopting it needs a per-loop check first
_withdrawn.status: withdrawn (W9r10 review D4, 2026-10-21): N76 records a candidate rule backed by 13 kernels, so by the notes' own evidence the design is not shown to be unfixable; it stays open work until the per-loop check of N76 (10 of the 14 corpus designs with the [HLS 200-960] warning are exact today) has been done

_withdrawn.status: withdrawn again (W9 round 12 review defect 4, 2026-10-22): the W9r12-prove proposal said '20 kernels have not found which source shape triggers it, so no general rule can be stated', but N76 states a candidate rule backed by 13 kernels (automatic pipeline only, a sub-loop unrolled only by that pipeline, no branch on the child's or sub-loop's index) and its next step, the per-loop check of the corpus designs that print [HLS 200-960], has not been done; the design stays open work until that check (the W9r10 review D4 withdrawal, above, still applies)
_withdrawn.why_out_of_scope_proposed_w9r12: Vitis refuses the flatten with [HLS 200-960] '... either the parent loop or sub loop is do-while loop', a loop rotation in the closed front end; 20 kernels (N64 / N76) have not found which source shape triggers it, so no general rule can be stated (W9r12-prove: the only DoD-5 straggler proposed; every other out-of-band class has a proven or known mechanism)
